We seek a dynamic and motivated Senior Analyst to join the Global Power Market Analytics and Research team. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the team and driving the research and modelling deliverables for the Asian markets focused mainly on South Asian countries, while supporting the wider APAC power and renewables team.
As a Senior Research Analyst in our Power & Renewables team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering actionable insights on policy developments, market trends, and investment dynamics across global power markets. Furthermore, you will collaborate closely with our modelling groups to enhance and refine our models and data, laying the groundwork. This position combines deep analytical work with client engagement, offering opportunities to influence strategic decisions in the energy transition. The role will involve staying informed on key market trends and incorporating the latest ideas into our power modelling and research reports.
Key Responsibilities:
Market & policy analysis : Track and interpret regulatory changes, policy frameworks, and investment signals impacting power markets. Assess implications of these changes on generation mix, pricing, and system operations.
Research & forecasting: Develop and refine technology outlooks and power price forecasts using regional power models. Incorporate emerging trends such as battery storage, curtailment, and grid flexibility into modelling workflows. Ensure forecasts are robust, bankable, and aligned with industry best practices.
Modelling & data enhancement: Collaborate with global research groups to improve modelling methodologies and data quality. Support the development of advanced analytical tools tailored for transaction and valuation support. Manage data workflows, conduct in-depth analysis, and ensure timely, high-quality deliverables.
Client engagement: Build and maintain relationships with clients and industry stakeholders. Deliver insights through presentations, reports, and bespoke advisory projects. Respond to client queries with clear, data-driven analysis.
Cross-functional collaboration : Work with various teams within the organisation to ensure smooth delivery of services and seamless integration of market research, data analytics, and commercial expertise into the transaction advisory process.
Requirements
Intellectual Curiosity & Collaboration:
·       Intellectually curious, collaborative, and highly organized, with a strong attention to detail.
·       Focused on delivering exceptional client services and committed to continuous growth and improvement.

Qualification/Experience:

- Work experience of 8+ years with any - developer, consultancy/ equity research, private equity, financial institutions, or another market/investment-focused organization

- Exceptional analytical/quantitative skills, including experience in modelling (Plexos, Aurora or any other platform) or commercial analysis in power markets.

- Experience with writing research papers and client presentations

- Comfortable working with large datasets, databases, and APIs, and familiar with tools like Python, SQL, and Power Query to handle and analyse data

- Experience in optimization models is an advantage, as is experience of modelling or commercial analysis in power markets

Knowledge & Skills:

- Strong knowledge and experience in power and renewables markets, with a particular understanding of power plant technologies, operations, and economics.

- Understanding of market trends, regulatory issues, and key drivers in power sector

- Familiarity with the enablers and implications of decarbonization in the energy sector

- undefined

Communication Skills:
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Fluency in additional European/ Asian languages is an advantage

The Role

We are seeking a full-time Power Market Analyst to join Wood Mackenzie’s Power & Renewables team, focusing on the development and application of advanced power market models across European electricity markets.
As a Power Market Analyst, you will play a key role in building, maintaining, and enhancing market optimization models used to analyse power systems, generation economics, transmission constraints, and market outcomes. You will apply linear programming (LP) and other optimization techniques to simulate market behaviour, assess investment and operational decisions, and provide actionable insights on power market dynamics, decarbonization pathways, and energy transition challenges.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and enhance optimization-based power market models for European electricity markets.

- Design and implement LP and mixed-integer optimization models to simulate generation dispatch, storage operation, cross-border trading, and market-clearing mechanisms.

- Analyse power market fundamentals, including supply-demand dynamics, renewable integration, fuel markets, emissions costs, and transmission constraints.

- Conduct scenario analysis to evaluate market outcomes, asset profitability, policy impacts, and energy transition pathways.

- Translate complex model outputs into clear market insights and recommendations for internal stakeholders and clients.

- Improve model methodologies, assumptions, and analytical frameworks to enhance model accuracy, transparency, and performance.

- Work with large datasets and develop efficient data workflows to support model development and analysis.

- Collaborate with experts across power markets, renewable energy, economics, and policy to deliver high-quality research and market intelligence.

- Monitor developments in European energy markets, regulatory frameworks, and market design, assessing their impact on market participants and investment decisions.

- Support client engagements through presentations, bespoke analyses, technical discussions, and thought leadership.

About You

We are looking for a highly analytical and intellectually curious individual with a strong foundation in optimization, quantitative modelling, and power market analysis. You enjoy solving complex problems, building robust models, and generating insights that support strategic decision-making.

Essential Skills and Qualifications

- A degree in Operations Research, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

- Experience in electricity market analysis, power system modeling, or energy economics.

- Strong knowledge of optimization techniques, particularly linear programming (LP) and mixed-integer programming (MIP).

- Experience developing and implementing mathematical models for power systems, generation portfolios, storage assets, or electricity markets.

- Proficiency in Python and/or other programming languages used for optimization and quantitative analysis.

- Experience with optimization frameworks and solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Xpress, Pyomo, or similar tools.

- Strong understanding of European power market fundamentals, market design, and price formation mechanisms.

- Ability to analyze complex datasets and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and commercial audiences.

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Why Join Us?

At Wood Mackenzie, you will work on industry-leading power market models that help clients navigate rapidly changing energy markets and the transition to a low-carbon economy. You will collaborate with leading analysts, modelers, and industry experts to solve complex challenges facing power systems, renewable integration, energy storage, and electricity market design.
This role offers an opportunity to apply cutting-edge optimization techniques and market analysis to inform investment decisions, support policy evaluation, and shape the future of the energy sector.

We are looking for a full-time Market Analyst, to join Wood Mackenzie’s Power Trading Analytics (PTA) team. The team’s research spans North American power market fundamentals and price forecasting to asset valuation and strategy that comprises some of the most highly utilized data, reports, and insights across Wood Mackenzie. Our broad industry knowledge and deep understanding of the North American power market are unparalleled and help our clients succeed during the energy transition. The Market Analyst will have a strong background in analytics and growing expertise within the power industry. About you and how you can excel in this role Wood Mackenzie’s PTA team comprises industry experts who are detail-oriented, intellectually curious, commercially savvy, and comfortable presenting to clients. Your interest in fundamental power market research proves you hold these characteristics and are comfortable taking complex, disparate ideas and distilling them into simple, actionable analytics. About the role The Market Analyst will serve as the driving force in the delivery of industry-leading short-term power outlooks based on a blend of proprietary and public data.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, math, stats, or energy-related discipline

- Previous experience in a power or trading vertical

- 2+ years of business or professional work experience

- Ability to lead and train entry-level associates and analysts

- You are committed to contributing to a welcoming and inclusive environment, are sensitive to diverse perspectives, and are passionate about equity in the workplace.

Nice To Haves

- Preferably to have experience in using programming languages such as Python, Visual Basic, or comparable languages

- Relevant ERCOT, MISO, or SPP experience

Responsibilities

- Participate in and lead the daily operational tasks with the Market Associate/Analyst group

- Ensure high-quality forecasts and analytics are provided to customers from the entire team

- Operate models and support tools daily that include spatial, data visualization, and power flow applications to identify and solve problems in the power industry-specific to an ISO market.

- Responsible for understanding and communicating Current-day/Next-day operational and financial risk to Asset owners, traders, retailers, etc. transacting in the markets daily, to assist them in making asset optimization decisions.

- Facilitate daily customer calls, talking asset owners, traders, retailers, etc. through their market questions and expectations. Lead customer trainings and demos on WoodMac Power Trading Analytics products

- Provide insights and risks associated with longer-term congestion patterns, transmission upgrades, and outages through quarterly seasonal outlooks.

- Ownership of initiatives related to efficiencies and products outside of routine daily operational tasks

- Run regional support workbooks daily and continuously improve the level of granularity provided to the team and customer.

- Manipulate large datasets and determine correlations and relationships between potential market drivers, prices, and events.

- Improve current processes by automating critical tasks using macros (visual basic/Python)

- Present the team’s ISO desk, lead, managers, and other decision-makers with research projects/presentations, memos, or reports on market-relevant topics as requested and advise on the effects of various courses of action relevant to specific problems.

The salary range for this position is $90,000- $120,000, which represents base pay only and does not include short-term incentive compensation or commission. When determining base pay, as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. This base salary maps to the Boston Location.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship

The Director of Pricing Operations is responsible for operationalizing Wood Mackenzie's pricing and commercial policies across systems, processes, and go-to-market workflows. This role serves as the collaborative bridge between Pricing, Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, Product, Legal, and Deal Desk to ensure pricing decisions are executed consistently, compliantly, and efficiently.
The role facilitates pricing governance, approval frameworks, deal support processes, pricing system administration, workflow automation, reporting, and controls. Success is measured by execution excellence, policy adherence, sales productivity, deal cycle efficiency, and operational scalability.
This role partners closely with the existing Pricing function and other commercial stakeholders to operationalize approved pricing strategies and commercial policies.

Main Responsibilities

Pricing Governance & Policy Execution:

- Lead the operational execution of pricing policies and commercial guidelines.

- Establish and maintain the governance framework, thresholds, and workflow through which pricing approvals and exceptions are reviewed.

- Ensure pricing decisions and policies are consistently executed across all regions, products, and sales channels.

- Lead pricing controls, auditability, and compliance with internal approval requirements.

- Drive continuous improvement of pricing governance processes.

Deal Desk & Commercial Approvals:

- Lead the operational administration and coordination of the Deal Desk function.

- Design and coordinate approval matrices, delegation of authority frameworks, and escalation paths, consistent with the existing Delegation of Authority Matrix.

- Oversee non-standard deal review and exception management workflows.

- Partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations to accelerate deal execution while maintaining policy compliance.

- Act as the primary coordination point for approvals that fall outside standard policy thresholds, routing them to the appropriate pricing, finance, or sales leadership for decision.

Pricing Systems & Technology:

- Lead pricing-related systems, tools, and platforms supporting quote-to-cash processes.

- Partner with Revenue Operations and IT to implement pricing changes in CPQ, CRM, ERP, billing, and related systems.

- Ensure pricing data integrity across all commercial systems.

- Define system requirements, enhancements, and automation opportunities.

- Lead testing, deployment, and change management for pricing-related system updates.

Process Design & Operational Excellence:

- Design and optimize end-to-end pricing and commercial workflows and systems (pricing methodology and price-setting itself remain with Pricing).

- Standardize processes across geographies.

- Identify bottlenecks and implement automation to improve efficiency and scalability.

- Develop operating procedures, documentation, and controls. Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve quote accuracy, approval turnaround times, and commercial execution.

Reporting, Analytics & Insights:

- Develop operational reporting and dashboards related to pricing governance and commercial performance.

- Monitor approval volumes, exception rates, turnaround times, policy compliance, and workflow effectiveness.

- Provide visibility into pricing operations KPIs and trends.

- Deliver insights that help leadership improve commercial execution and decision-making.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

- Act as the primary operational partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, Product, and Legal.

- Translate strategic pricing decisions into executable operational requirements.

- Lead cross-functional governance forums and stakeholder alignment activities.

- Ensure organizational readiness for pricing changes, product launches, and commercial initiatives.

People Leadership

- Attract, develop, and retain high-performing talent aligned with business priorities, fostering an inclusive and engaged team culture.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition and other stakeholders to identify skill gaps, recruit effectively, and ensure diverse and high-quality hiring decisions.

- Onboard new hires effectively, embedding Wood Mackenzie’s purpose, strategy, and culture from day one.

- Drive performance through clear goal setting, regular feedback, coaching, and structured career development conversations.

- Encourage ownership of Personal Development Plans (PDPs) and support continuous growth and career progression.

- Conduct regular performance and talent reviews, addressing underperformance proactively while recognising and rewarding achievement.

- Ensure effective communication, collaboration, and compliance across all team operations, including utilisation, policies, and engagement initiatives.

About You

- Demonstrable experience in pricing operations, deal desk, revenue operations, or commercial operations roles.

- Proven people leadership and development experience (directing professional staff).

- Experience administering CPQ, CRM, or billing systems in a B2B corporate environment.

- Exceptional background in process design, governance, and internal controls; process-excellence methodology (e.g., Lean/Six Sigma) is a plus.

- Experience building and scaling cross-functional approval and escalation frameworks.

- Advanced proficiency in Salesforce, Excel, and BI/reporting tools.

- Collaborative stakeholder management background across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product functions.

Expectations

We are hiring an experienced Research Analyst to Japan power and renewables research. This role is designed for candidates who are strong in market analysis, data analytics, and power modelling , and who can convert structured or unstructured inputs into clear, evidence-based market insights.

The Team
You will work with Wood Mackenzie’s Power & Renewables research team across APAC and global markets. The team combines market intelligence, long-term modelling, and structured research workflows to support high-quality insight generation.

Key Responsibilities

Work with local research team to maintain core market datasets and conduct power market analysis for the Japan market.

- Support production of high-quality, forward-looking insights by preparing accurate and well-structured evidence packs.

- Maintain and run the Japan long-term power market forecast model in Aurora , with guidance from senior analysts.

- Build and update structured research databases (policy, projects, company updates, and source tracking) with clear verification status and source traceability.

- Monitor key developments in policy, market rules, project pipeline, and company disclosures; organize information into reusable research inputs.

- Perform data QA checks, resolve inconsistencies, and improve data reliability across recurring workflows.

- Support cross-team requests by delivering well-documented charts, tables, and summary materials.
